title: lead_questions
description: Standard AlgoBridge Infotech lead qualification flow for clients and students

user_type.name: Are you looking for IT services for your business, or are you a student interested in internships?

name.name: Nice to meet you! What should we call you?

email.name: What's the best email to reach you?

phone.name: What number can our team contact you on?

interest_area.name: Which area are you most interested in? (e.g., Web Development, Mobile Apps, AI/ML, Data Science)
interest_area.fallback: What is your area of interest?

education_level.name: If you are a student, what is your current education level?

project_requirements.name: If you are a business, could you briefly describe your project requirements? (If student, you can say skip)
